{"title": "Home: links", "type": "markdown", "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": false, "markdown": "### MediaWiki

- [mediawiki-errors](#/view/mediawiki-errors): runtime warnings, fatal errors and uncaught exceptions
- [mediawiki-new-errors](#/view/mediawiki-new-errors): the same, without errors already reported in Phabricator
- [mediawiki](#/view/mediawiki): all MediaWiki records by level, channel and host

### Searching

- Find one request: `reqId:"…"` in [Discover](../discover)
- Records of one channel: `type:mediawiki and channel:Flow and level:INFO`
- Exceptions of one class: `exception.class:"Wikimedia\\Rdbms\\DBQueryError"`

These dashboards come from the docker-logstash image (`dashboards/mediawiki.ndjson`) and are restored on each Logstash start. Change them there, not here."}, "aggs": []}
